name: escalation-freshness-gitcwd
title: Align review-escalation freshness-root to gitCwd so floor and escalation agree under wrapper-root layouts
description: evaluateReviewEscalation recomputes evidence freshness from args.projectRoot, while the review-assurance-floor and the verdict producers use the resolved gitCwd. In wrapper-root layouts (git root != metadata/project root) escalation reads freshness from the wrong root, so the same host_verdict can be downgrade-accepted by the floor yet read as stale/null by escalation. Make escalation gitCwd-aware and prove floor<->escalation hash equivalence.
